summary: Implemented the source-checkout build.sh web launcher as an additive root script with dependency preparation, packaged frontend build support, optional llm_bridge startup, foreground appforge web delegation, bounded smoke verification, and updated source-start documentation.
features_completed: Added executable repository-root build.sh with safe loopback defaults, --help, --check, --no-open, and --smoke modes.
Implemented Python environment preparation through uv sync --extra dev with a python3 venv/pip fallback and clear missing-command errors.
Implemented frontend preparation that installs frontend dependencies only when node_modules is missing and runs npm --prefix frontend run build unless skipped.

Delegated normal runtime to .venv/bin/appforge web, preserving browser opening by default and honoring APPFORGE_WEB_HOST, APPFORGE_WEB_PORT, APPFORGE_LOG_LEVEL, APPFORGE_NO_OPEN, and existing APPFORGE_* runtime variables.
Implemented finite no-browser smoke verification that starts appforge web, probes /api/health and /, then kills only the launcher-owned server PID.
Implemented optional llm_bridge reuse/startup only when APPFORGE_DRIVER=llm-bridge or APPFORGE_START_LLM_BRIDGE=1 is selected, with APPFORGE_SKIP_LLM_BRIDGE as an escape hatch.
Updated README.md, docs/WEB_APP.md, and CHANGELOG.md so ./build.sh is the easiest source UI path while preserving manual appforge web and frontend dev commands.
commands_run: APPFORGE_SKIP_INSTALL=1 APPFORGE_SKIP_FRONTEND_BUILD=1 APPFORGE_WEB_PORT=8799 ./build.sh --smoke (sandbox run failed with local bind operation not permitted)
APPFORGE_SKIP_INSTALL=1 APPFORGE_SKIP_FRONTEND_BUILD=1 APPFORGE_WEB_PORT=8799 ./build.sh --smoke (approved local bind run passed)
git diff -- build.sh README.md docs/WEB_APP.md CHANGELOG.md
decisions: Keep build.sh as an additive shell launcher rather than changing appforge web internals, because the existing FastAPI/Vue runtime already owns serving and browser-opening behavior.
Use APPFORGE_DATA_DIR for launcher smoke and bridge logs so runtime files align with the existing web app state directory.
Use curl for HTTP health probes because it is available on the target macOS/local shell environment and keeps the launcher independent from Python snippets during polling.
Run llm_bridge only for explicit bridge mode or APPFORGE_START_LLM_BRIDGE=1 so default auto/codex/claude/generic users are not blocked by Bun or provider setup.
Keep --smoke and --check skip-friendly so prepared workspaces can verify startup without network-dependent dependency installation.
known_gaps: First-run dependency installation was not exercised because network downloads are not allowed by the current AppForge runner; skip-mode verification used the prepared workspace.

Launcher-owned llm_bridge startup was not exercised with Bun because the implementation stage only verified the bridge skip/reuse branch locally; full provider-backed operation still requires user credentials and bridge dependencies.

traceability.evidence: Executable launcher delegates to .venv/bin/appforge web with 127.0.0.1:8787 defaults and browser opening unless no-open is selected.
ensure_python_env and ensure_frontend implement uv/venv/npm setup and skip flags.
--smoke starts appforge web with --no-open-browser, probes /api/health and /, and cleans up the owned PID.
maybe_start_bridge only acts for llm-bridge or APPFORGE_START_LLM_BRIDGE and respects APPFORGE_SKIP_LLM_BRIDGE.
Docs promote ./build.sh, smoke/no-open/check options, bridge behavior, and retained CLI/manual commands.
